why: A heap of end times, one per station: process trips by departure, and at the trip's origin reuse the bus that became free earliest if it is free by the departure time, otherwise add a bus. The earliest finisher is the only one worth checking, which is exactly what a min-heap gives.
hints: This is meeting rooms with a twist: a bus is only reusable at the station where its last trip ended.

Sort trips by departure. For each station keep a min-heap of times when idle buses arrived there. At a trip's origin, if the smallest time <= departure, pop it (reuse); otherwise count a new bus. Push the trip's arrival time onto the destination's heap.
O(T log T) for T trips. Times arrive as strings: convert with int().
pitfalls: Compare times as integers, not strings ("10" < "9" as strings).
A bus that arrives exactly at the departure time can take the trip (<=).
